item.tib: rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyung mthu chen gyi tshogs kyi shog chung
item.coloph: ces tshogs kyi shog chung 'di yang / snying grogs dge rgan sa trig sam sad kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rgod rje rgya bon gyi rus thob/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa bdag gis shar grol smin gling du 'phral du spel ba 'dis kyang / tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
